name: deliver-code
description: Scaffold durable engineering context and deliver approved vertical code slices through TDD, review, and verification.

steps.title: Inspect the repository and reconcile the safe scaffold
steps.instruction: Identify direct or delegated mode, show the status header, and perform only authorized additive scaffold writes.

steps.title: Clarify an ambiguous engineering request
steps.instruction: Run only when material ambiguity could change the engineering boundary; direct mode may clarify scope, while delegated mode may not reopen product scope.

steps.title: Sharpen changed domain language and qualifying decisions
steps.instruction: Run only when vocabulary changes or a qualifying durable decision crystallizes.

steps.title: Define a bounded architecture or design change
steps.instruction: Run only when the approved change alters module, API, data, or interaction boundaries; update current architecture separately from durable ADR rationale.

steps.title: Create or reuse the canonical approved specification
steps.instruction: Store the canonical specification under docs/specs and reuse an existing approved request for a clear small fix.

steps.title: Create dependency-aware vertical delivery tickets
steps.instruction: Prefer authorized GitHub Issues; otherwise store stable local tickets under .scratch/deliver-code/<work-id>.

steps.title: Approve the delivery plan and mutation envelope
steps.instruction: Present scope, route, test seams, tickets, verification commands, and separately authorized mutations before implementation.

steps.title: Implement one dependency-ready ticket with TDD
steps.instruction: Invoke this skill only when commit permission is explicit; otherwise execute the approved implementation phase with mattpocock:tdd and do not commit. Work one approved vertical ticket at a time.

steps.title: Diagnose an unexpected failure inside the approved ticket
steps.instruction: Run only when implementation or verification fails; do not expand scope.

steps.title: Review repository standards and specification fidelity
steps.instruction: Run both review axes against the approved fixed point; prepare a review handoff and pause when subagent execution is unavailable.

steps.title: Collect fresh completion evidence
steps.instruction: Collect and evaluate native structured evidence for the approved focused and full commands; block completion on failed, stale, unavailable, mismatched-workspace, or partially mapped evidence.

steps.title: Accept or rework the direct delivery result
steps.instruction: Present implemented behavior, review findings, verification evidence, residual risk, and the exact re-entry point.
